title: •Put That Down
caption: •Put That Down (V)
game_text: If your character or starship is about to be captured or lost during the weapons segment of a battle, it is hit instead and may not be captured or lost until the damage segment. OR If opponent just played an Interrupt during battle, activate 2 Force.
lore: Lord Vader interceded between the trigger-happy mercenary and his target.
